reference_dataset: GeoNames cities15000 (CC BY 4.0), held locally; modern coordinates used ONLY as point references, never as boundaries
notes: Route A (graticule) was exhausted in MAPGEN-015 and was not repeated. Route B was attempted once, in bounded form: nine candidate windows on sheet f1 were cropped at native resolution with autocontrast and inspected. Weimar's walled town outline was identified with HIGH confidence. Erfurt's clearly drawn star is the Petersberg citadel rather than the town centre, so it was rejected. Four windows, placed from a downscaled overview, simply did not contain their target town. Two points cannot define an affine transform, let alone a fit/holdout split with spatial stratification. This source is therefore declared exhausted FOR THIS SCAN: it is not to be pursued further for 6 km control resolution unless a better scan or another edition appears.
